author: GamingBolt
description:
We had the chance to dive into Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection ahead of its release and we're here to share our thoughts! Does this collection of retro titles from an era of gaming long gone manage to hold up to modern standards? 

Do Geo and Omega-Xis form a protagonist duo that can keep you invested in their character arcs across these games? How do the ports perform on modern hardware? We're answering all of that and more in our review, breaking it down to help you decide if the nostalgia alone is worth diving back into these rather under-appreciated additions to the Mega Man franchise's long line-up of titles. 

Join us as we take this one head on, and see if you find something you like along the way.
title: Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
Incoming from Ghostrunner devs One More Level is Valor Mortis, a self-declared Soulslike fought in first-person. Set in a supernatural, Napoleonic nightmare, Valor Mortis – while not the first attempt – might be the most serious stab yet at shifting Soulslike’s surgical precision to first-person. 

With melee combat, especially, first-person perspectives are where countless games have struggled. Spatial awareness, depth perception, field of view; how will One More Level ensure responsiveness and fluidity when the camera naturally frames the action tightly?
title: Valor Mortis Might Be The Wildest First Person Soulslike Yet

author: GamingBolt
description:
As Crimson Desert was more exposed over the past two years, comparisons to Red Dead Redemption 2 inevitably emerged. Not for nothing, because the latter is still, to this day, one of the greatest games ever made and a significant benchmark for open-world immersion and storytelling. 

So while it's certainly superior in numerous aspects, how close does Crimson Desert get to matching it? Which areas are completely different and unique? Let's dive into it, starting with...
title: How Close Is Crimson Desert to Red Dead Redemption 2?
